biotools.summary: pan-Draft is a tool for automated reconstruction of species-representative metabolic models from multiple genomes, addressing the challenges of incomplete data in metagenome-assembled genomes. It leverages a pan-reactome-based approach to create high-quality draft models and an accessory reactions catalog.
